name: WARNING: Black Bean Spaghetti (Extreme Insoluble Legume Fiber)
whyItWorks: An extreme fiber bomb containing 12g of dense, indigestible black bean fiber per serving. In an inflamed gut or strictured intestine, this creates massive fermentation pressure and severe transit friction.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Completely avoid black bean pasta. It is one of the single most disruptive pasta substitutes for inflammatory bowel disease.
